resources.string: Enter the address of the Ostrom server you sign in to. Agents propose, people decide.
No account on this device uses this server yet. Check the address before you sign in.
No server yet? Look around with sample data, kept on this device only.
Nothing here is real. Deploy your own Ostrom server to use the app.
You sign in with GitHub on your Ostrom server. Your yes is signed in your name.
Enter the code below on the page that opens, as with ostrom login.
Waiting for you to confirm in the browser…
This server does not offer GitHub sign-in, which this app uses.
This server is invite-only: open your invitation in a browser to create your account, then sign in here.
Your session on %1$s ended. Sign in again to see it.
This computer has no keyring: your sessions are kept in memory only and end when the app quits.
Signed out on this device. The server could not be reached; its session expires on its own.
Signed out on this device, but its secure storage refused access: the session may stay valid until it expires.
This server speaks API v%1$d; this app speaks v%2$d. Update the app or ask your administrator to update the server.
This server is too old for this app: it does not say which API version it speaks (this app speaks v%1$d). Ask your administrator to update the server.
This device's secure storage refused access. Unlock it and try again.
Enter the address of your Ostrom server, with https://.
This server does not offer GitHub sign-in.
No Ostrom server answers at this address.
You belong to several organizations, and Ostrom needs to know which one: choose it in Settings.
Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$d s.
The server answered with an error (HTTP %1$d).
The server answered with an error (HTTP %1$d, %2$s).
GitHub or the server refused the sign-in.
The code expired before the sign-in was confirmed. Start again.
This sign-in did not come from this app. Try again.
This Ostrom instance is invite-only: open your invitation in a browser to create your account, then sign in here.
Your session ended. Sign in again.
The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
This server does not offer this feature.
This server speaks another version of the API than this app. Update the app or ask your administrator to update the server.
The server sent a sign-in page this app does not trust. Nothing was opened.
Ostrom wants a fresh sign-in for this yes: confirm it in the console.
